listenings.text: Good morning, Eduardo. Renata Lima, from the academic office. The Thursday seminar is full, so we are opening a second group on Friday. The Friday group is smaller: ten students. However, it has the same professor and the same reading list. The room is different. It is room 310, on the third floor. Although Friday is a long day for you, I recommend it, because the class starts at seven in the evening. Please choose a group before Monday. After Monday, I choose for you.

Eduardo, Paulo Rezende. I want to explain my decision about the corn. We did not sell in March, because the price was low: one hundred and ten reais a bag. So we kept the corn in our storage. Storage costs money, about two reais a bag every month. However, the price in May was one hundred and thirty, so we earned more. But the buyer in Cairo wants the cargo before June. Although the contract is ready, I need you to read clause nine today.
